people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Barzillai
people.line: Ancestor of a priestly family who returned from exile.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Habaiah
people.line: A priest whose descendants were unable to prove their lineage.

people.name: Hakkoz
people.line: A post-exilic priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood.

translations.web: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
translations.bsb: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, the descendants of Hakkoz, and the descendants of Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).
translations.kjv: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
translations.asv: And of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
